title: Relocation Allowance Contracted under the Hotel Rate Plans Range
content:
Where a property cannot honour a reservation as booked, the amount reimbursed is contracted against the plan the reservation was sold on. The schedule below states that amount for every plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range.

| Rate plan | Relocation allowance, per room per night |
| --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 125.00 USD |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 125.00 USD |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 150.00 USD |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 175.00 USD |
| Member Flex Rate | 200.00 USD |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 250.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 300.00 USD |

The figure is the amount reimbursed per room per night when the property cannot honour the reservation.

*Hypothetical arithmetic.* Two rooms advised for two nights on the Member Flex Rate, whose allowance is 200.00 USD, come to 800.00 USD: the allowance multiplied by two rooms and then by two nights. The same two rooms and nights on the Non-Refundable Saver Rate, whose allowance is 125.00 USD, come to 500.00 USD.
